usedFor: Cody.ai holds your bots and documents, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computer after “New Documents” through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Documents” in Cody.ai, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new document can kick off a script on your own machine, such as a backup.

watchOut: Cody.ai triggers are polling, so “Trigger Command” runs after a scheduled check.
